summary.title: Add Champagnie (now a free agent), drop Bailey
summary.headline: Julian Champagnie (SAS, SF/PF) went unclaimed on waivers and is a free agent: add now, drop Ace Bailey.
summary.verdict: Small but consistent gain in both projection sets. No waiver priority spent.
risks: Effect is ~2 SE: real but small.
± are Monte Carlo SEs only (2 seeds × 3,000).
rationale: - Champagnie: 3s, rebounds, few turnovers; projects ~10 more games than Bailey.
- Playoffs +0.4 to +0.7 pp, title +0.6 to +1.0 pp (season-sim-0.6.0 paired, simulated).
- Free agent now: instant add, no waiver priority (we are already last).

why_now.before: Draft pick 156 was an exact tie with Bailey; on 10-21 we proposed a waiver claim (approval expired unanswered).

changed.text: Waivers cleared 10-22 and nobody claimed him: he is a free agent.
Re-checked with in-season projections (ros-proj-0.3.0): still positive, smaller title gain.
